newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan-April home aluminium sales up 16.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan-April home aluminium sales up 16.6 pct.

text.p: Brazilian internal sales of all primary aluminium reached 70,200 tonnes in January to April, up 16.6 percent on the 60,200 tonnes sold in the same period in 1996, said Brazilian Aluminium Association (ABAL).
Sales in April reached 19,100 tonnes, up 24 percent from 15,400 tonnes in April last year and a rise of 9.8 percent on the 17,400 tonnes sold in March 1997.
This is the highest monthly sales in the last 24 months, surpassed only by the 22,400 tonnes sold in March 1995.
ABAL is expecting total domestic sales to reach 218,000 tonnes in 1997 against 196,500 tonnes in 1996.
But this forecast could change if recent credit restrictions announced by the government start hitting demand, ABAL said. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
